excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]已经收集齐所有解锁L-星门网络的必要认知！一旦他们研究了L-星门科技并完成一项特殊任务来开启他们境内的L-星门，他们将可抵达L-星团。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] has gathered all the insights necessary to unlock the L-Gate Network! Once they have researched the L-Gate technology and finished a special project to open an L-Gate within their borders, they will have access to the L-Cluster.
